title: 3 Canadian Dividend Stocks With Yields Over 3%
summary: Rising bond yields have restored a clear premium for longer term government debt, so cash and short term instruments no longer carry the only attractive headline yields. That shift has pushed many Canadians to rethink how they earn regular income from their portfolio. Reliable dividend payers with yields above 3% and a track record of covered, growing payouts offer one clear route. This article highlights three such Canadian dividend stocks for closer examination.
